## Install on your Android phone

1. On your phone, tap **LubaVoice-AI.apk** below to download it.
2. Open the downloaded file. If Android asks, allow your browser or Files app to **install unknown apps**.
3. Open **LubaVoice AI**, tap **Try the demo lines** or **Import** your own, and allow the microphone when asked.
4. If **Listen** says there is no Greek voice: open **Guide → Install Greek voice**, download Greek, then tap **Check again**.

New versions install over the old one and keep your progress.

## Use it on a computer

Download **LubaVoice-AI.html** and open it in Chrome. Works offline. On a Mac, add the free Greek voice “Melina” in System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System voice → Manage Voices.
